stories.title: 5-for-5 Day-After — De-Commit Wave Hits Programs Nationwide

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
Day after Signing Day. Programs already pulling offers. 😔

Memphis de-committed three Class of 2027 commits: Cassidy Ott, Kinley Patten, and Isabell Gonzales — all due to the 5-for-5 roster squeeze.

Rachel Lawson called "casualties." She was right.

#NCAASB

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
Cassidy Ott was "involuntarily de-committed" from Memphis. The 5-for-5 rule + 25-player cap are squeezing out 17-year-olds who had nothing to do with this mess.

The NCAA created it. Athletes are paying for it. 🏳️

#NCAASB #Softball
